notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, act Feb. 11, 1897, ch. 216, 29 Stat. 526, related to entry of mineral oil lands under placer mining laws. See section 181 et seq. of this title.

notes.heading: Savings Provision
notes.text: Section 193 of this title contains a savings provision protecting valid claims in existence on Feb. 20, 1920.
